summary: Restore reports live progress like backups do, and a truncated .dlb upload names the reverse-proxy body limit instead of blaming the file.
highlights: Restore now shows a live progress bar with the current phase — decrypting, per-model load, per-file writes, and finalize — instead of a bare 'running' badge.
A finished or failed restore raises a notification; progress survives a page reload because it is persisted on the SystemRestore row.
A backup upload cut short by the reverse-proxy body limit reports the truncated transfer instead of 'not a valid .dlb file'.
DLUX_DLB_UPLOAD_MAX_MB makes the 512 MB upload cap configurable; copying a large .dlb into the backup folder stays the route for multi-GB snapshots.
